data.name: Haabeen
data.gender_notes: Haabeen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-b-n', Haabeen means gentle, tender, and compassionate. In Islamic tradition, it is mentioned in a Hadith describing the character of Prophet Muhammad's wife, Aisha (RA), who was known for her gentle and compassionate nature. The name Haabeen carries the meaning “Gentle, Tender, Compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haabeen usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, tender, compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes new beginnings, growth, and renewal.
data.etymology: Haabeen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Tender, Compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haabeen total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
